conceptZh: 太陽燈和月亮燈拔河，把「日」和「月」拉近。
object: toy sun lamp and moon nightlight
morph: sun square and moon crescent pulled together into 明
creativeAngle: 兩盞燈拔河，啪一聲靠在一起。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second animated comedy, locked frontal camera. Setting: a deep-sky-blue stage that stays light; the glyph is warm gold 日 on the left and silver-blue 月 on the right. A bouncy astronaut toy stands between them holding two ropes. The Traditional Chinese glyph 明 stays centered and uncropped at about 70% of frame height with generous margins. Moment one (0.0-1.8s): the astronaut gives each lamp a rope and they tug apart; the first 明 is spoken as ropes go taut. Moment two (1.8-3.5s): the ropes spring back and 日 and 月 snap shoulder to shoulder, both flashing softly once; the second 明 is spoken at the snap, the astronaut bouncing off the floor. Moment three (3.5-5.0s): a calendar page of tomorrow flaps open with a sunrise sticker; 明天 is spoken as the sunrise sticker rises. From 5.0-8.0s the glyph 明 is perfectly still and unobstructed; the astronaut waves with both gloves while a tiny star twinkles. Narration (off-screen only, Taiwanese Mandarin, unhurried, every tone clear, no erhua): the voice says exactly 「明、明、明天」, read as ㄇㄧㄥˊ、ㄇㄧㄥˊ、ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄊㄧㄢ. Timing: first utterance at about 0.5s, second at about 2.4s, the word at about 4.4s; then stop, no repeats and no extra speech. Beneath the voice only gentle rope twangs and a soft chime, no music. The single glyph is the only on-screen text; the vocabulary stays audio-only with no subtitles, watermark, clutter or flashing.
